how: Villa Olivia in Bartlett (about 45 km west) runs small snow-made slopes for skiing with group, private and kids lessons in winter; Wilmot Mountain in Wisconsin (190 ft vertical, about 85 km north) is the nearest larger hill.
Villa Olivia in Bartlett (about 45 km west) offers snowboarding with group, private and kids lessons on small man-made-snow slopes in winter.
Norge Ski Club in Fox River Grove (about 60 km northwest) has a ski-jump hill with tournaments and a junior program and summer camp; it is a membership club rather than a drop-in facility.

No desert or dune field suitable for sandboarding near Chicago; the nearest established sandboarding is at Great Sand Dunes National Park in Colorado, well over 1,500 km away (equipment rentals at Alamosa).
No free-roaming African wildlife around Chicago; Brookfield Zoo (about 22 km west) has African savanna exhibits with lions, and real safaris are in Africa.
